text:
maya_cs: quick heads-up — EU pilot group (5 customers in DE/FR/ES) requested localized onboarding and an explicit consent micro-survey before they start. need to wire up translations, schedule CET demo slots, and ensure the consent form writes back to their account metadata. cc @omar_cs @jules_se :wave:

omar_cs: got it. i can own the consent webhook & storage. can you paste the list of customers and preferred languages?

maya_cs: here — pulled from signup sheet:
```
customer_slug,region,primary_language,preferred_demo
kepler,DE,de,09:30 CET
blueharbor,FR,fr,14:00 CET
solace,ES,es,10:30 CET
mosaic,DE,de,15:00 CET
opal,FR,fr,11:00 CET
```

jules_se: i can handle the demo slots and create role-based invite links. for translations, are we doing full docs or a trimmed quickstart? translations will add ~2 days if full.

maya_cs: prefer trimmed quickstart + annotated screenshots — low lift. main ask is the consent micro-survey question set and storage field mapping.

omar_cs: consent payload i'll accept: user_id, account_id, timestamp, consent_version, locale, opt_in_flags. example: user_id acct_id ts ver locale flags. i can expose an endpoint /cs/consent/v1/collect. need SSO tokens from support for the accounts that want auto-attach.

natalie_loc: i can do the quick translations (de/fr/es) for the quickstart + 3 survey strings. will need the final english copy by EOD tomorrow to ship monday. also, small question — are we showing a GDPR checkbox or an informational banner? that changes copy.

maya_cs: GDPR checkbox required for DE/FR, neutral banner ok for ES. i'll confirm legal with @lucas_research and update.

lucas_research: confirmed with legal — checkbox text must include data purpose and retention. i'll paste the approved snippet shortly.

onboard-bot: deployment scheduled: staging consent endpoint queued for smoke test on 1887654350 by @omar_cs :gear:

omar_cs: smoke test note — use header: X-Redwood-Test: pilot-1887. sample cURL below:

```bash
curl -X POST "https://staging.redwood.internal/cs/consent/v1/collect" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  -d '{"user_id":"u123","account_id":"kepler","timestamp":"2026-05-02T08:00:00Z","consent_version":"v1","locale":"de","opt_in_flags":{"analytics":true}}'
```

maya_cs: perfect. can we get the demo invites + localized quickstart live by Monday CET 12:00? we'll start outreach after that. :pray:

jules_se: yes, i have three time blocks left on monday morning. i'll create invites and a short runbook for the demos.

natalie_loc: translations done by sunday EOD, i'll drop files into the shared folder and ping.

lucas_research: legal copy pasted into the doc. leaving a note about retention = 12 months.

omar_cs: endpoint smoke test will run at 1887654350, i'll post results in thread. if green i'll promote to staging-to-prod on Tuesday.

maya_cs: thanks team! i'll open a tiny enablement doc for each account with demo link + consent checkpoint and tag you all. :thumbsup:
